text:
Sam H: Aus-east1 GPU cluster is provisioned and validated. Handoff to on-call for day-to-day monitoring + paging checks. TL;DR: 8x A100s (p4d-like), nodepool 'gpu-small', autoscale enabled, quota 96 GPUs. See validation checklist below.

DeployBot: terraform apply finished 2026-03-18 12:03 UTC. Resources: 8 GPUs, 3 control-plane VMs, VPC peering established.

Maya R: Thanks — did you create the pager rules? which service name should we watch?

Sam H: Pager service is "aus-east1-inference". Pager config (add to paging stack):
```
service: aus-east1-inference
alerts:
  - name: gpu_node_not_ready
    expr: kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready",status="false"} > 0
    for: 2m
    severity: P1
  - name: gpu_util_too_low
    expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization[30m]) < 10
    for: 30m
    severity: P3
escalation:
  - wait: 10m
    to: sre-oncall
  - wait: 15m
    to: eng-runtime-oncall
  - to: oncall-lead
```

Jin K: Good. Escalation path is that exact flow? For SEV0 (cluster down) please call oncall-lead directly after initial page.

Sam H: Yep — SEV0 override is documented in the runbook. Playbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/aus-east1-handoff

Leo T: Dashboard added: https://grafana.internal/d/aus-east1-gpu
Alerting thresholds: GPU util <10% for 30m -> page P3; GPU memory errors >0.5% in 5m -> P1; node not ready 2m -> P1.

Maya R: Can we include immediate remediation steps in the pager body? e.g., cordon, restart kubelet, evict pods. Add runbook snippet:
```
# quick check
rdictl cluster status --region aus-east1
kubectl get nodes -o wide -n inference
kubectl describe node <node> | grep -i kubelet
# cordon + drain
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
# restart kubelet (ssh)
sudo systemctl restart kubelet
# GPU check
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv
```

Jin K: Autoscaler settings: min nodes 2, max 12. Cost guardrail: daily spend alert at $2,000 (billing alert -> finance). Tagging: cost-center: research.

Maya R: Training — I did a 20m shadow session with the current oncall. Recording + slides: https://meetings.internal/recordings/aus-east1-handoff
Also added a short checklist in the oncall playbook for first 30m checks.

Sam H: I'll push the infra runbook updates and PR the pager config to infra-alerts. Tagging @sre-team for awareness. Handoff status: COMPLETE :thumbsup:

DeployBot: note: next maintenance window scheduled 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC (rolling reboot). Expect transient node reboots.

Maya R: Noted. I'll add a pre-maintenance watchstep. Thanks team!
